description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Precision Calibration: Delivers accurate firn-probe calibration with a certified accuracy class of 1.94%, supporting precise measurement requirements in scientific and industrial applications.
  • Wide Operating Temperature Range: Engineered to function reliably at low temperatures, with an operating threshold of -23°C, making it suitable for cold environment usage such as polar research or refrigerated facilities.
  • Fast Sampling Rate: Offers a rapid sampling rate of 912.2 Hz, ensuring real-time data acquisition and consistent calibration performance for dynamic or time-sensitive measurements.
  • Long Calibration Interval: Requires recalibration only every 29 months, reducing maintenance frequency and minimizing downtime for users.
  • Fixed Base Mounting: Comes with a fixed base for secure and stable installation, supporting consistent operation and safety during use.
  • Six-Axis Compatibility: Designed to match the six-axis measurement standards common in the category, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of probes and calibration protocols.

Main Benefits

  • Reliable and Consistent Results: High accuracy and stable mounting provide dependable calibration outcomes, essential for quality assurance in laboratory and field settings.
  • Reduced Maintenance Costs: Extended calibration interval lowers the total cost of ownership and decreases the need for frequent service interruptions.
  • Versatile Environmental Performance: Operates efficiently in sub-zero conditions, meeting the needs of users working in extreme climates or temperature-controlled environments.
  • Real-Time Data Support: Fast sampling rate meets the needs of applications requiring immediate feedback and high-frequency measurement, such as environmental monitoring or process control.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Scientific Research: Ideal for laboratories and research teams calibrating firn-probes for glaciology, environmental science, or climate studies, where accuracy and reliability are critical.
  • Industrial Quality Control: Supports manufacturing or quality assurance teams needing precise calibration in cold storage or refrigerated production lines.
  • Field Deployment: Suitable for mobile calibration setups in remote or harsh environments due to robust temperature tolerance and stable installation design.
  • Long-Term Monitoring Projects: Perfect for projects where minimal recalibration is desired, supporting continuous data collection with minimal disruption.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the unit easy to install?
    Yes, the fixed base ensures straightforward and secure mounting on standard surfaces.
  • How often does it require recalibration?
    The calibration interval is 29 months, significantly reducing maintenance needs.
  • What environments is it suitable for?
    Designed for reliable operation down to -23°C, making it ideal for cold storage, polar research, and other low-temperature applications.
  • What is the sampling speed?
    The calibration bench samples at 912.2 Hz, supporting high-speed data acquisition requirements.

This firn-probe calibration bench is engineered for users seeking precise, reliable calibration in demanding environments, with long service intervals and robust performance across a range of scientific and industrial applications.
